title: Raccoon wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 36,38 64,38' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <polygon points='46,8 40,24 52,24' fill='#ff5e7a'/>
  <polygon points='56,8 50,24 62,24' fill='#4dc3ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='4' fill='#ff7ad9'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='42' r='11' fill='#8b93b8'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='42' r='11' fill='#8b93b8'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='42' r='6' fill='#c9a8d8'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='42' r='6' fill='#c9a8d8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='30' ry='26' fill='#9aa3c9'/>
  <!-- mask -->
  <path d='M20,52 Q50,40 80,52 Q80,66 50,66 Q20,66 20,52 Z' fill='#5f6a99'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='54' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#3a4466'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='54' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#3a4466'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='54' r='4.5' fill='#fff1a8'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='54' r='4.5' fill='#fff1a8'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='54' r='2' fill='#2b2b40'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='54' r='2' fill='#2b2b40'/>
  <circle cx='37.5' cy='52.5' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='65.5' cy='52.5' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#2f3760'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='65' rx='2' ry='1.3' fill='#8c96c4'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#e6dcff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42,75 Q50,82 58,75' stroke='#6b6f96' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='72' r='1' fill='#8b93b8'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='72' r='1' fill='#8b93b8'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='68' r='4' fill='#f292b8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='68' r='4' fill='#f292b8' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
